highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.4 prevents reuse of uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes.

bullets.detail: Drops uniquely held thread-safe-cache entries after unsuccessful rendering so later draws cannot reuse those entries' uninitialized textures. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.

v4.152.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.4 corrects Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes.
v4.152.4.body: The update removes uniquely held entries that could reference uninitialized textures; entries still held elsewhere are unaffected.
